# Python console output

Code keeps its shaded background and syntax colors. Results appear separately.

```{python}
print('  <result>& "quoted"\n    second line')
```

```{python}
print('-' * 160)
```

```{python}
from IPython.display import display
display({'answer': 42})
```

```{python}
import sys
print('Diagnostic message', file=sys.stderr)
```

```{python, error=true}
raise ValueError('Example error')
```

```{python, echo=false}
print('Output from hidden source')
```
